title: CodeChallenge: Do nouns or adjectives have longer trajectories? (part 1)

cues.en: In this code challenge, you will integrate identifying parts of speech using the Spacy library.
cues.zh: 這次程式挑戰，會整合用 spaCy 辨識詞性，

cues.en: As you learned in the previous video, and calculating properties of state space trajectories.
cues.zh: 也就是上一支影片學過的內容，以及計算狀態空間軌跡的性質，

cues.en: As you learned a few videos before that in particular, you will import some text, identify lots of
cues.zh: 這是再前幾支影片學過的。具體而言，先匯入文字，辨識大量

cues.zh: 名詞與形容詞，將隱藏狀態活化投影成狀態空間軌跡，

cues.en: then determine whether nouns or adjectives have longer trajectories.
cues.zh: 再判斷，名詞或形容詞，哪個軌跡比較長。

cues.en: That is a pretty interesting analysis to run, because both nouns and adjectives are not necessarily very interpretable on their own.
cues.zh: 這項分析很有意思，因為名詞與形容詞，單獨看都不一定很容易解讀，

cues.en: You really need a context to make sense of them.
cues.zh: 確實需要上下文，才能理解。

cues.en: For example, adjectives modify nouns or pronouns, typically nouns that are close by, but at least in the same sentence.
cues.zh: 例如，形容詞修飾名詞或代名詞，通常是附近的名詞，至少也在同一句中。

cues.en: Now nouns, on the other hand, generally tie together information about subjects and objects and verbs, and they're just important words in the sentence.
cues.zh: 另一方面，名詞通常將主詞、受詞與動詞的資訊連結起來，是句子的重要字詞。

cues.en: And as you are going through this these exercises, I would like you to make a prediction about whether
cues.zh: 完成這些練習時，希望你先預測，

cues.en: you think the state space trajectories will be longer for nouns or for adjectives.
cues.zh: 自己覺得名詞還是形容詞的狀態空間軌跡，會比較長。

cues.en: Anyway, let's begin with exercise one.
cues.zh: 總之，從練習一開始。
